opportunities.exact_result: For finite reaction vectors, positive Caratheodory rates with uniform all-time/all-path logarithmic profiles on the full exponent cube, and every essential order minimizer strictly inward at every cube direction including lower faces, every positive stoichiometric class has one compact convex common invariant finite-time absorber; all positive solutions are global. Entry is uniform over admitted paths and, additionally, over initial points in any fixed positive compact subset of the class.
opportunities.main_mechanism: A fixed finite nonseparable affine minimum approximates active exponent directions under an arbitrary positive, possibly discontinuous slope gauge. Coordinate gauge forces zero-slope global plateaux; finite selected normal gaps give fixed-scale positive drift. Arbitrary initial points first lie in a sufficiently small invariant compact plateau, then finite nonnested square-root scales reach one class plateau.
opportunities.load_bearing_lemma_status: Arbitrary-gauge affine induction internally reconstructed and hostile-audited, including all ties and outside-cube approach sequences.
compatibility: The all-time/all-path uniform bound is essential; pointwise time limits are insufficient.
All lower reaction-normal faces must be tested; generic directions alone are insufficient.
Standard locally uniform Caratheodory Lipschitz hypotheses remain required; UV supplies compact growth bounds.
Profiles automatically vanish at zero and are positively homogeneous where both scaled directions lie in the cube.
early_falsifiers_preserved: 0<->X with w_plus=exp(-t), w_minus=x satisfies pointwise profiles and all-direction inwardness but tends to zero; UV fails.
0->Y, 2Y->Y, X+Y->Y has x(t)=x0 exp(-t) for y0=1 and fails exactly a lower-face direction; generic-sector checking is invalid.
Finite separable affine sums cannot satisfy the full arbitrary-gauge lemma for the exposed diagonal gauge.
